existing_group_assignments.rationale: Liver cancer is a general liver tumor event, related to the hepatocellular carcinoma and liver tumor events in this group but differing in specificity.
Lipid peroxidation is the same process as 'Increase, Lipid peroxidation' and the oxidation of membrane lipids, differing only in specificity.
Protein adduct formation concerns the same protein object as alkylation and covalent binding, but is a distinct description of the process.
Binding to the voltage-gated sodium channel shares the sodium channel object but does not by itself establish inhibition or modulation.
Decreased locomotor activity is the same endpoint as 'Decreased, locomotion', which is the opposite direction to 'Increased, locomotion'.
